title: Predictive Modeling of Grapevine Red Blotch Disease Using Multi-Temporal Remote Sensing and Spatial Epidemiology

contributions.purpose: 融合空间流行病学与机器学习预测 GRBV
contributions.mechanism: 多智能体 AutoML(Analysis/ML/Domain agents)整合高光谱+空间自相关+寄主易感因子
contributions.evaluation: 20 次迭代实验,末次 F1=0.97(precision 0.95, recall 0.98)
contributions.domain: 精准农业 / 植物病害预测
contributions.source_quote: Integration of spatial epidemiology principles with machine learning to enhance GRBV prediction accuracy.

contributions.purpose: 提供可扩展的运营化预测框架
contributions.mechanism: 数据驱动、可扩展的病害预测流水线
contributions.evaluation: 运营化框架(定性;数据因 grower 隐私不公开)
contributions.source_quote: Development of a scalable, data-driven framework for operational disease forecasting in viticulture.

contributions.purpose: 识别前症状感染的关键特征
contributions.mechanism: 分析特征重要性(历史病害计数/邻域效应/植被健康)
contributions.evaluation: 仅空间自相关特征即达 F1=0.81;历史计数为最强特征
contributions.source_quote: Identification of critical remote sensing and spatial features indicative of pre-symptomatic GRBV infection.

notes: 数据红旗:目标变量为 redvine_count_2024>0,而最强特征是 'historical disease counts'(往年同地块病害计数)——疑似目标泄漏,作者自认 'the model's heavy reliance on historical counts suggests it may [过拟合历史模式]';F1 跨度 0.01→0.97 极大,且 0.97 依赖大量特征工程 + SMOTE 合成少数类过采样,疑似挑结果/过拟合;单产区单季(2021–2024 同园)数据,自认需跨园跨季验证;数据集因隐私不公开,不可复现。checklist 自认无显著性检验(仅点估计 F1/R²)。
